title: El Libro --- And a Word Made of Tree Bark
label: ch:noun-libro
canDo: I can say el libro and tengo un libro, and contrast it with la casa as a gender pair.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C43-libro: produce el libro and tengo un libro, and say what Latin liber originally named.
payoff.note: Pairing one masculine and one feminine everyday noun is the point: from here every gender-dependent rule has two plain test cases.
